verified: JPL's Matthew Golombek, speaking at the Nov. 10 MEPAG meeting, described the SkyFall plan — three helicopters released about 1 km above Mars, landing independently, flying every other sol, a six-month prime mission with a one-year goal, and an identical five-instrument payload on each vehicle led by a flexible-antenna ground-penetrating radar — and said the project has grown from roughly six people to over 200 since NASA initiated it in March 2026.
unconfirmed: that SR-1 Freedom will be ready for the late-2028 launch window, or that the 2030 capsule release and helicopter deployment sequence will work; no firm launch date, cost figure, or independent assessment of the nuclear spacecraft's schedule has been released, and Hubbard's "shotgun marriage" criticism is one expert's opinion rather than an official finding.

verified: Golombek 在 MEPAG 会议上介绍了 SkyFall 的三架直升机、2028 年底发射、2030 年秋季释放、6 个月主任务、5 台仪器和探地雷达等方案；Space.com 报道了这些内容。
unconfirmed: SR-1 能否在 2028 年窗口前就绪仍无保证，Hubbard 公开质疑其进度；SkyFall 的具体科学飞行路线尚未确定，报道也未给出确切发射日期、任务成本或独立验证结果。

titles.en: NASA's SkyFall helicopters to ride the SR-1 Freedom nuclear spacecraft to Mars
titles.zh: NASA SkyFall火星直升机拟搭乘核动力飞船，专家质疑
